reactingreactions.jei.drilling.coolant: The rig needs a trickle of coolant.
reactingreactions.jei.drilling.lubricant: The rig needs a trickle of lubricant.
reactingreactions.jei.drilling.rate_item: 1 dust per %s s at %s RPM, %s s at %s RPM
reactingreactions.jei.drilling.rate_oil: %s mB/s at %s RPM, %s mB/s at %s RPM
reactingreactions.jei.drilling.richness: Rates are for a full-richness vein; poorer is slower.
reactingreactions.jei.induction.burner: Works as a Blaze Burner under machines.
reactingreactions.jei.induction.heat: 3x3: %s V smoulders, %s V heated, %s V superheated. Bigger needs more.
reactingreactions.jei.induction.shape: A filled rectangle, at least 3x3, one connector.
reactingreactions.jei.multiblock.heat_no: No heat required by any recipe
reactingreactions.jei.multiblock.title: Multiblock Structure
reactingreactions.jei.multiblock.tower.h: Blaze Burner directly beneath the floor
reactingreactions.jei.multiblock.vat.ele: 2 electrode columns, terminals in the end walls
reactingreactions.jei.multiblock.voltage: Min. voltage depends on the recipe
A hollow 3x3x3 box of Airless Oven walls. Place the controller in the middle of a side, one block above the floor.
It heats itself: no burner needed.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.0: A 3x3 tower around a column of Drill Pipe: Derrick Blocks in the corners of three layers, Trusses on the sides of the top and bottom layers. Formed, it turns into a full derrick.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.1: Feed rotation down into the controller from a shaft above it, at least 32 RPM, up to 128 RPM for full speed.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.2: Run Drill Pipe from the frame down to a head touching a Rich Vein. The head decides the job.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.3: The oil head sips lubricant (seed oil or mineral oil). The mineral heads sip coolant, 1% brine (used twice as fast) or drill grease (lasts four times longer). Feed either through the controller or any Derrick Block.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.4: Full-richness vein: oil 10 mB/s at 32 RPM up to 40 mB/s at 128 RPM; dust 1 per 50 s at 32 RPM down to 1 per 12.5 s at 128 RPM. A poorer vein is slower.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.5: The diamond head drills every vein, 2x as fast.
reactingreactions.jei.page.derrick.6: Fluids and items go through the controller and any Derrick Block, never the trusses.
reactingreactions.jei.page.distillation_: A hollow tower of Distillation Tower walls, at least 3x3 and 3 tall. Place the controller anywhere on the shell.
Heat comes from Blaze Burners or an Induction Heater beneath it.
The floor row takes the input. The second row does nothing. From the third row up, each row is one output.
reactingreactions.jei.page.electrolysis_: A roofed box of Electrolysis Vat walls in two sizes: 5x3 and 3 tall, or 7x5 and 4 tall. Place the controller in the middle of a long side, one block above the floor.
Stand two electrode columns inside, from the floor to just under the roof, one next to each end wall on the middle line.
A terminal sits in each end wall, beside its column, one block above the floor. Attach the wires there.
The voltage across the electrodes must reach the recipe's minimum. Some recipes only accept certain electrodes.
Pipe in the fluid to split. The results leave through the walls.
reactingreactions.jei.page.fermentation_: Cannot make: %s. Those need the Reaction Chamber (stirring, heat or more slots).
One block that needs no power. It is slow, has no stirring and no heat.
reactingreactions.jei.page.induction_hea: A filled rectangle of Induction Heater Plates on one level, at least 3x3 and at most 16x16, with exactly one Connector anywhere in it.
The connector holds both wire terminals. It points toward you when placed, in any of the six directions.
Resistance is 10 ohm per block. A bigger heater needs proportionally more voltage for the same heat, so the power per block stays the same.
It works as a Blaze Burner under machines. Heated coils hurt what stands on them.
reactingreactions.jei.page.machine_attac: For a formed Reaction Chamber, Electrolysis Vat or Airless Oven. Outlet Manifolds and Gaskets are used on the machine and go into it; sneak with an empty hand to take the last one out. The others mount against the outside of a wall.
Small machines take 4, large ones 8; any more do nothing. The goggles show how many are used.
Outlet Manifold: one more output tank. Expansion Tank: +4000 mB in every tank.
Machine Gauge: a comparator signal of the progress, or of how full the fullest output is. A Wrench switches it.
Gasket: toxic contents no longer leak; it also seals a Create Fluid Tank. Circulation Pump: faster recipes, by half at 256 RPM.
Encased pipes and Plastic Pipes never leak; glass pipes leak half as much as plain ones.
reactingreactions.jei.page.reaction_cham: A hollow, roofed box of Reaction Chamber walls, in two sizes: 3x3 and 4 tall, or 5x5 and 5 tall.
Place the controller in the middle of a side, one block above the floor. Once formed, it turns into a full machine.
A steel-encased shaft takes the middle of the roof. Its speed must fit the running recipe's RPM band.
Heated recipes need Blaze Burners or an Induction Heater under the floor, in an X shape.
Fluids and items go in and out through the walls.
The small one has one output tank and takes 4 attachments; the large one has two and takes 8.
reactingreactions.jei.page.rich_veins.0: Rich Veins generate inside natural veins, after everything else: about 9 in 10 veins of Create's rocks (asurine, crimsite, ochrum, veridium, scoria), 3 in 10 tuff, granite and diorite blobs, and every oil vein.
reactingreactions.jei.page.rich_veins.1: Each has a richness from 1 to 5, rolled when it generates. Level 4 and 5 drill at full speed.
reactingreactions.jei.page.rich_veins.2: A drill head touching one drills it: the oil head for oil, the steel head for tuff, scoria, granite and diorite, the titanium head for asurine, crimsite, ochrum and veridium. Plain rock or plain oil shale does nothing.
reactingreactions.jei.page.rich_veins.3: They glow faintly. Mining one is very slow and it survives explosions. It drops a stack of the plain rock, never itself, so it cannot be moved.
reactingreactions.jei.page.rich_veins.4: Operators can find the nearest one with /richvein.
reactingreactions.jei.page.small_electro: Cannot make: %s. Those need the Electrolysis Vat with specific electrodes, or more than one fluid or a lot of items.
One block that splits simple fluids with any electrodes. It needs power: each recipe has a minimum voltage.
Held in either hand, the Acetylene Lamp lights up its surroundings
Using it supercharges the lamp for half a minute, burning some of its Acetylene
While supercharged, undead nearby catch fire, and no monsters spawn around its holder
Refill it with Acetylene from a Spout or a Charging Pad
reactingreactions.ponder.airless_oven.te: Airless Ovens are hollow 3x3x3 boxes of Oven Walls, the Controller in the middle of a side
They provide their own heat, no burner required
They can be used to bake Coal into Coke, or Wood into Charcoal and Carbon Monoxide
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_1: Derricks are 3x3x3 towers around a column of Drill Pipe: Derrick Blocks in the corners, Trusses on the sides of the top and bottom layers
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_2: Fluids and items can be piped in and out through any Derrick Block
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_3: The Derrick Controller sits on top, and needs at least 32 RPM from a shaft coming down into it
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_4: Drill Pipe continues down into the ground, ending in a Drill Head next to a Rich Vein
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_5: The type of head decides what the rig produces
reactingreactions.ponder.derrick.text_6: Faster rotation, up to 128 RPM, and richer veins speed up the rig. The vein is never used up
reactingreactions.ponder.distillation_to: Distillation Towers are hollow columns of Tower Walls, at least 3 by 3 and 3 tall
Blaze Burners underneath provide the heat
Fluids are piped into the bottom row
Starting from the third row, each row outputs one product
Taller towers can separate more products
With Create Diesel Generators installed, distilling runs in its Distillation Tower: a Fluid Tank at least 3 tall, turned into one with a Distillation Controller
Blaze Burners underneath provide the heat
Fluids go into the bottom level, and each level above holds one product
Crude Oil gives Naphtha, Diesel, Gasoline and LPG, from the bottom up
reactingreactions.ponder.electrolysis_va: Electrolysis Vats are closed boxes in two sizes: 5 by 3 and 3 tall, or 7 by 5 and 4 tall
Two columns of Electrodes go inside, from the floor up to the roof, one next to each end
The Controller goes in the middle of a long side, one block above the floor
A Terminal in each end wall, beside its column, is where the power supply's wires attach
Each recipe requires a minimum voltage
Fluids and items can be inserted into and extracted from any wall
Some recipes also require a specific Electrode material
reactingreactions.ponder.gas_diffuser.te: Gas Diffusers work like Aeronautics' burners, but fill balloons with Helium or Hydrogen
The gas is piped into the Diffuser's tank, and slowly used up while it runs
Both lift more than hot air. Hydrogen lifts the most
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_1: Some fluids are toxic, as shown on their tooltip
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_2: Tanks, pipes and machines holding them leak now and then. Liquids drip down and pool on the floor
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_3: The drips lead back to the leak. Glass pipes leak less; Encased and Plastic Pipes never do
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_4: A Gasket used on a Fluid Tank seals it. Sneak with an empty hand to take it back
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_5: Gases jet out of one side with a hiss, then hang in a cloud
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_6: Both foul the air, harming anyone nearby, plants and animals. Mild ones, like hydrogen, do not
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_7: Flammable leaks catch fire near flames, and large ones explode
reactingreactions.ponder.leaks.text_8: Floor Drains soak up nearby pools into a tank, which pipes can empty
reactingreactions.ponder.lithium_brine.t: Distilling Water boils most of it off as Steam, leaving a little Weak Brine
Distilling Weak Brine again concentrates it into Strong Brine
A heated Mixer turns brine into Lithium Brine and Salt, sometimes with Borax
Superheated, Lithium Brine gives Lithium Nuggets
reactingreactions.ponder.lithium_brine_c: In a Distillation Tower, Water boils off as Steam, leaving a little Weak Brine on its own level
Distilling the Weak Brine again concentrates it into Strong Brine
A heated Mixer turns brine into Lithium Brine and Salt, sometimes with Borax
Superheated, Lithium Brine gives Lithium Nuggets
reactingreactions.ponder.machine_attachm: Reaction Chambers, Electrolysis Vats and Airless Ovens take Attachments
Used on the machine, an Outlet Manifold goes into it and adds an output tank, for recipes with more products
An Expansion Tank adds 4000 mB to every tank
A Machine Gauge gives a comparator signal: the progress, or how full the fullest output is. A Wrench switches it
A Gasket seals the machine: its toxic contents no longer leak. Sneak with an empty hand to take an upgrade back out
A Circulation Pump speeds recipes up with the rotation it gets, by half at 256 RPM
Small machines take 4 attachments, large ones 8
reactingreactions.ponder.mineral_drill.t: Mineral Drill Heads turn Rich Veins of stone into dust
Steel heads can drill Tuff, Scoria, Granite and Diorite
Titanium heads are needed for Asurine, Crimsite, Ochrum and Veridium
Mineral drilling consumes Coolant, supplied through any Derrick Block
The dust can be extracted from any Derrick Block
reactingreactions.ponder.oil_drill.text_: Rich Oil Veins can be found deep inside veins of Oil Shale
An Oil Drill Head next to the vein will pump Crude Oil
The rig needs a supply of lubricant, such as Seed Oil or Mineral Oil
Crude Oil can then be extracted from any Derrick Block
reactingreactions.ponder.ore_dusts.text_: Crimsite Dust smelts into Pig Iron, the start of steel
Granite Dust, superheated in a Mixer, splits into Alumina and Quartz
Ochrum Dust is electrolysed into gold and lead, with Gold-Steel Electrodes
With Lead Electrodes and Sulfuric Acid, Veridium and Asurine are electrowon into copper and zinc
Crushing Wheels grind ore-bearing stones, such as Asurine, into dust
Some dusts are roasted: superheated with Oxygen in a Reaction Chamber, they give their metals
Asurine gives zinc, Veridium copper, Tuff nickel, and Scoria lead and sulfur
Merely heated, two dusts and Blaze Powder work too, more slowly
Ochrum, Crimsite and Granite each take their own way
Naphtha from a Distillation Tower can be cracked into lighter gases
Pipe it into a heated Reaction Chamber together with Steam
The stirring shaft must turn between 24 and 64 RPM
Each product needs its own output tank: an Outlet Manifold used on the chamber adds the second one
Ethylene and Propylene come out together, and can be pumped out of any wall
Both are the base of plastics, and each can be turned into the other
reactingreactions.ponder.plastics.text_1: Ethylene and Silica (quartz dust), heated and stirred in a Reaction Chamber, give Liquid HDPE
reactingreactions.ponder.plastics.text_2: Cast in a Mixer, it sets into HDPE Pellets, which craft into HDPE Sheets
reactingreactions.ponder.plastics.text_3: Propylene with Aluminum Nuggets gives Liquid Polypropylene instead, which casts straight into sheets
reactingreactions.ponder.plastics.text_4: Plastic can be crushed back into pellets
reactingreactions.ponder.polymetallic_no: Polymetallic Nodules lie in small patches on the ocean floor. Fishing sometimes brings one up
Crushing Wheels break them into Crushed Nodules
A heated Mixer refines them into Manganese
with a chance of Nickel, Zinc and Rare Earth Dust on the side
reactingreactions.ponder.reaction_chambe: Reaction Chambers are hollow boxes of Chamber Walls in two sizes: 3x3 and 4 tall, or 5x5 and 5 tall
The Controller goes in the middle of a side, one block above the floor
A Steel Encased Shaft in the centre of the roof stirs the contents. Each recipe requires a certain speed
Some recipes require heat from Blaze Burners, placed under the floor in an X pattern
Fluids and items can be inserted into and extracted from any wall
reactingreactions.ponder.rich_veins.head: Rich Veins
reactingreactions.ponder.rich_veins.text: Rich Veins are rare blocks hidden inside natural deposits of stone and oil shale
Each has a richness from 1 to 5. Richer veins can be drilled faster
They can be recognised by their faint golden glow
Breaking one only drops the plain stone, so drill it instead
Small Electrolysers can process simple electrolysis recipes when powered
Fermentation Barrels process small reactions slowly, without any power
reactingreactions.ponder.staying_safe.te: Exposure to toxic compounds fills a gauge above the hunger bar
Carrying toxic fluids, breathing fouled air or standing in pools raises it
High levels harm you more and more. A full gauge is deadly
It goes down slowly, faster with Charcoal Tablets and Antidotes. Gas Masks, Chemical Gloves and Boots protect you
Atmospheric Scrubbers clean the air around them, with rotation and Activated Carbon. Lye doubles their effect
Inside a sealed room, they cover a much larger area
Pools can also be cleaned by hand with Soap, Bleach or a Sponge
Gas Vents let piped gases out of the way. Toxic ones still pollute, unless a scrubber covers the vent

reactingreactions.ponder.titanium.text_1: Titanium starts as Titanium Tetrachloride, mixed superheated from Crimsite Dust, Coal Coke and Bleach
reactingreactions.ponder.titanium.text_2: It is pumped on to a second Mixer
reactingreactions.ponder.titanium.text_3: Superheated with a Magnesium ingot, it gives Titanium
reactingreactions.ponder.titanium.text_4: Magnesium comes from an Electrolysis Vat: Magnesium Chloride with Graphite Electrodes
reactingreactions.ponder.titanium.text_5: Reacted with Oxygen in a Reaction Chamber, the Tetrachloride gives Titanium Dioxide instead
